criteria.text: The example names each role's required context, exclusive writable files and durable handoff, while keeping governing instructions and unresolved evidence available.
The example waits for a long check on its original batch and tells me when the coordinator resumes, without treating unchanged tool progress as a new decision.
A delayed failure, repair and changed draft preserve the failed expectation and return to the required approval before further checking.
Independent verification and a long external native process preserve coverage, process identity, progress, cancellation and unsuccessful or unknown outcomes.

cases.given: A fresh author finishes the three service drafts; CHECK remains running beyond 90 seconds then completes.
cases.required_observation: AC1, AC2: Inspect the supplied brief and owned paths, original batch and terminal result. No inherited transcript; required instructions/dependencies remain accessible. Tool progress alone does not create coordinator reasoning.

cases.given: The long CHECK reports expected Available, actual Reserved; an author changes the owning prompt.
cases.required_observation: AC3: Keep the failure and exact expectation. Repair receives the failed criterion and scope only with required context. Show changed drafts at their gate; never auto-approve or rewrite the expected value.

cases.given: Drafts are approved and implementation is available for native verification.
cases.required_observation: AC4: A fresh eligible verifier calls the real boundary with approved cases and required regressions. A separate fresh reviewer receives governing rules and relevant contracts; neither is the author.

cases.given: The tool interrupts a running CHECK after its batch is saved.
cases.required_observation: AC2, AC4: Preserve batch and recovery command. Continue with the printed read once and long wait; retain original IDs and unknown/failed outcomes. Existing runCheck fake-engine test covers this CLI boundary only.

cases.given: A long authorized VM validation fails; a repaired rerun later passes.
cases.required_observation: AC4: Keep command/source/cwd, actual session or PID/start identity, stdout/stderr and exit receipt for both runs. Same required coverage. Use native runner completion control, never CHECK read as process supervision.

cases.given: User cancellation or lost runner connection occurs during external validation.
cases.required_observation: AC1, AC4: Cancel only the owned runner identity and await its result when supported; absent receipt remains unknown. State notification/wait limits and count necessary status turns. Do not claim cancellation from a file or a Runtime scenario.
